publishedfiledetails.title: The Ultimate Mod Testing and Reviewing Area - Main Files
publishedfiledetails.description:
This map pack is made to test your work-in-progress mods in peace.
Spawn and pick up any weapon, item, upgrade and carryable object.
[hr][h3]Warning:
TUMTaRA is not designed for use with heavily resource-intensive addons.
Poorly optimized addons with high-poly models and 4k textures can cause crashes.
If you experience crashes, disable these addons or use the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2189362870]dedicated maps[/url].

You must load these maps via console right after game start to use them properly!
Alternatively, use the main menu launchpad [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2256147202]here[/url].
You could also use any main menu mod that supports the launcher, like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3032403531]this[/url].

Cheats will be forced off when launching addon maps after playing any other map.
I can't do anything about it because that's a bug in the game itself, not my maps.

If you want to report a bug, do it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/469986973/590685961608796978/]here[/url].[/h3]
[hr]Mapnames:[b][list]
[*]tumtara
[*]tumtara_l4d1
[*]tumtara_legacy (pre Aug.2026)
[*]tumtara_l4d1_legacy (pre Aug.2026)[/list][/b]
Contains:[list]

[*]Vomit overlay tester
[*]SI, CI & UCI Spawner
[*]Buttons to add weapon upgrades, enable godmonde, etc.
[*]A bunch of commonly modified props
[*]Surivor model Animation cycler[/list]
